evidence_items.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
evidence_items.explanation: The report describes possible AI contributions as small and difficult to separate from other factors. It concerns AI broadly and a longer period, so it is context rather than decisive evidence about GenAI in the target quarter.

evidence_items.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
evidence_items.locator: Time Savings and Productivity Gains, final paragraph
evidence_items.explanation: Reported workplace benefits challenge a reading that no productivity benefits existed. The authors separately caution that translating these savings into measured aggregate productivity remains uncertain; time savings do not settle the contracted measure.

The accompanying forecast envisages productivity growth gains over a ten-year period as adoption spreads. It establishes a prominent promise, but not a commitment that those gains would already exist by March 2025.
